owner_scope: All repository-documented PVNetwork research work: first complete all 93 COMPLETE-RESEARCH-v1 gates, then COMPLETE-REFERENCE-v2 for all applicable entries. Completion of one protocol/family is never overall completion.

hard_phase_lock.reason: V1 tracker is not 93/93 COMPLETE-RESEARCH-v1. V2 evidence may be preserved or captured incidentally, but V2 must not be the active campaign until V1 reaches 93/93.
forbidden_while_locked: select a new V2-only work unit instead of reconciling unfinished V1 gates
use missing runtime/device/packet-capture/certification evidence as a hidden research-completion gate unless the written V1 contract explicitly requires it

active_work_unit.exact_next_action: Stop expanding unrelated V2 work. Reconcile mature V1 dossiers against the exact 20-item completion checklist in research/PROTOCOL_RESEARCH_TEMPLATE.md, in deterministic matrix order starting with entry 001 unless a more mature entry can be closed immediately. For each entry: map every gate to traceable evidence; mark N/A only with evidence-backed rationale; explicitly record genuine research gaps; complete those gaps; and update research/RESEARCH_COMPLETENESS.md to COMPLETE-RESEARCH-v1 in the same work unit when all applicable research gates pass. Runtime/device/container/interoperability/packet-capture/production certification is not a hidden V1 gate unless the written contract explicitly requires it. Preserve all already-created V2 evidence; do not delete it, but do not make V2 active until V1 is 93/93.

resume_policy.on_single_task_blocker: record blocker, change strategy after two failed attempts, continue independent required V1 work
resume_policy.on_platform_interruption: treat as interruption not completion; next invocation resumes from repository checkpoint immediately
resume_policy.on_work_unit_pass: update tracker, checkpoint, and immediately select next unfinished V1 entry until V1 is 93/93
resume_policy.overall_stop_gate: all required v1 and v2 gates PASS, or every remaining task is externally blocked and no independent work remains

files: research/REFERENCE_V2_COMPLETENESS.md only when V2 is legitimately active
docs/PROJECT_STATE.md or a dated status snapshot

last_checkpoint.summary: Follow-up audit confirmed the prior run continued V2 expansion after the phase-order correction and even produced commits after a recorded RUN_END without a new RUN_START. The repository state is therefore hard-reset to V1 gate reconciliation. Existing V2 research is preserved as useful evidence but is not the active campaign. Owner-visible counters must move only through evidence-backed tracker promotion.
